audit.whatIsWrong: Every single chart row contradicts its own why. Sides read Jax / Skill x5 / Jax, while whys[0] says level 1 is even, whys[1] through whys[3] and whys[5] all say Jax is ahead, and whys[4] and whys[6] say you flip it.
audit.why: The packet chart matches all seven whys exactly, so the prose was written against the packet and the sides were never updated. 44.36% over 1995 games confirms a Jax-favoured lane with two Volibear windows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Skill / Jax / Jax / Jax / Volibear / Jax / Volibear, ratings 5/3/3/3/7/3/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and spikes[3] both credit Volibear's ultimate with attack speed and an 'armor/MR steroid' or 'shred'.
audit.why: That is Jax's ultimate, not yours. Grandmaster-at-Arms increases his Armor and Magic Resist; Stormbringer grants bonus Health, a slow, and a tower disable, on 160/135/110s. Reading your own ult as a resistance buff makes you take a fight you lose.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer grants bonus health and disables the tower — the durability is health, and the window is level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike is described only as 'dodges autos + stuns' with no numbers, and it is the single ability the whole page is built around.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies', 300 range, 17/15/13/11/9s. The cooldown almost halves across the lane, which is why the early windows are wide and the late ones are not.
audit.corrected: 17s at rank 1 down to 9s at rank 5; it dodges attacks, then stuns at 300 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] says he can 'dodge your Q dash with Leap Strike'.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is not a dash — Riot's text says he 'gains speed towards enemies'. Leap Strike (700 range, 8s at rank 1) leaves your walk-up; it does not dodge a dash that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Leap Strike out of your walk-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Fight him even late' with generic filler underneath.
audit.why: Relentless Assault increases his attack speed on consecutive basic attacks, so the longer the trade runs the worse it gets for you — that is the actual reason for the don't.
audit.corrected: His passive stacks attack speed the longer you stand and trade.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer flips the fight — the extra HP, attack speed and armor/MR shred let you dive through his E stun window and win the extended trade if you time your engage after his Counter Strike detonates.
edits.after: Stormbringer flips the fight — 160s at rank 1, it grants bonus health and disables his tower, so dive after Counter Strike detonates. Time the leap for the moment his 17-second E is spent.

edits.before: Late, your R armor/MR steroid plus tanky Juggernaut build lets you survive his burst and win once his E cooldown is down, especially with Grasp/bruiser items.
edits.after: Late, your bonus health from Stormbringer plus a tanky build lets you survive his burst and win the window after his E, which is 9s at max rank.

edits.before: Post-6 and into items you stabilize — R Stormbringer's shred and durability let you punish his E cooldown windows and reclaim the extended fight.
edits.after: Post-6 and into items you stabilize — Stormbringer's bonus health and slow let you punish the 9-to-17 second gap after his Counter Strike.

edits.before: Dodge your Q dash with Leap Strike
edits.after: Leap Strike out of your walk-up

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Counter Strike: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1 down to 9s; it dodges attacks, then stuns at 300 range.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dodges attacks, then stuns at 300. It is 17s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Relentless Assault stacks attack speed the longer you stand and trade.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges attacks then stuns at 300 range; 17s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5. Leap Strike is 700.

notes: I adopted the packet chart because it is the only reading that agrees with all seven of this page's whys. The mirror (jax__volibear) was set to Volibear / Skill / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax, which differs on rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 — flagged for the user. Deliberately NOT asserted: whether Counter Strike's dodge window eats Thundering Smash's stun. The stun rides the attack that follows the walk-up and Counter Strike dodges attacks, which suggests it does; the mirror's page claims it does not; Riot's text settles neither, so no page text was written either way.
